pageTitle: cyTell us if you need support
heading: cyTell us if you need support
skipButton: cyI do not need any support at this time

contentBlocks.text: cySome people need support to access information and use our services. We call this a reasonable adjustment.

bullets: cybringing support with you to the hearing, like an assistance dog
cydocuments in an alternative format, like large print
cyregular breaks during a hearing to make you feel more comfortable

contentBlocks.text: cyYou can ask for a reasonable adjustment now by selecting ‘Continue to the questions’, or at any time during your case by selecting ‘Your support’ from your case overview.

cyOnce you’ve submitted your request for support, it’ll be reviewed by the court or a judge. We’ll keep you updated on the status of the request in your account. If we need more information we’ll contact you by the preferred method you’ve already chosen.
cyYou must contact the court directly to ask for something else for you or someone else who’s coming to court to support you.

bullets: cycommunication and documents in Welsh or to speak Welsh at your hearing
cyspecial measures, like giving evidence in private, because you’re vulnerable

contentBlocks.text: cyUse the find a court or tribunal service (opens in new tab) to get your local court’s email address. If you do not know the name of your local court, select the ‘Money’ category and then the ‘Housing’ category to find it.
